# Official sample files

Whole documents published by the standard's owners, used by the test suite.
Third-party real-world files are never committed; the corpus tests find them
through `GAEBBOSS_CORPUS`.

| directory | file | provenance |
|---|---|---|
| `3.1/` | `Musterdatei_3.1_2008-00*.X8*` | gaeb.de, "Musterdateien GAEB DA XML 3.1 2009-12" (Musterdateien_GAEB_DA_XML_3.1_2009-12.zip), unmodified |
| `3.3/` | `bvbs_bauausfuehrung.x83` | BVBS Prüfdatei GAEB DA XML 3.3 Bauausführung, V 04.04.2024, as published for certification |
| `3.3/` | `bvbs_bauausfuehrung.x84` | BVBS Prüfdatei GAEB DA XML 3.3 Bauausführung, V 11.06.2021 |
| `3.3/` | `bvbs_texterstellung.x81`, `.x82` | GAEB Prüfdatei GAEB DA XML 3.3 Texterstellung, V 11.06.2021 |
